drafter.private_reasoning: The proposed edits establish balanced mutual confidentiality protections without disclosing client-confidential information. Commercial terms remain subject to client approval.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Please find our proposed revisions to clarify the scope of confidential information, permitted use and disclosures, customary exclusions, and return or destruction obligations. We have retained the draft’s twenty-four-month agreement term and three-year protection period, clarifying that the latter runs from each disclosure. The remedies provision remains mutual. Please let us know your comments.

edits.text: 1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to explore a potential transaction (the “Purpose”) and may exchange confidential information. Each party may act as a disclosing party or a receiving party. Neither party is obligated to disclose information or proceed with any transaction. No license or other intellectual property right is granted by disclosure.
edits.name: Purpose and mutuality

edits.text: 2. CONFIDENTIALITY. In consideration of the mutual promises herein, each receiving party shall use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose and protect it with at least reasonable care and no less care than it uses for its own similar confidential information. “Confidential Information” means nonpublic information disclosed by or on behalf of a party in any form that is identified as confidential or reasonably should be understood to be confidential, including analyses reflecting that information and the existence and status of discussions. The receiving party may disclose Confidential Information only to its personnel and professional advisers who need to know it for the Purpose and are subject to confidentiality duties at least as protective as this Agreement. The receiving party is responsible for their compliance. Confidential Information excludes information the receiving party can demonstrate was lawfully known to it without restriction before disclosure, becomes public other than through a breach of this Agreement, is lawfully received from a third party without a confidentiality duty, or is independently developed without use of Confidential Information. If disclosure is legally required, the receiving party may disclose only what is required and shall, to the extent legally permitted, give prompt advance notice and reasonably cooperate, at the disclosing party’s expense, in seeking protective treatment. Upon written request, the receiving party shall promptly return or destroy Confidential Information, except that copies required by law or professional retention requirements, and routine backups not reasonably accessible for deletion, may be retained subject to this Agreement’s continuing restrictions.
edits.name: Mutual confidentiality obligations

edits.text: 3. TERM. This Agreement takes effect on the date of the last signature and remains in effect for twenty-four months. The receiving party’s confidentiality and use restrictions apply to each disclosure for three years from its disclosure date, notwithstanding expiration of this Agreement. Information qualifying as a trade secret shall remain protected for as long as it qualifies as a trade secret under applicable law.
edits.name: Term and survival

edits.text: 4. REMEDIES. Each party acknowledges that unauthorized use or disclosure of Confidential Information may cause irreparable harm for which damages may be inadequate. Either party may seek injunctive relief, subject to applicable law and judicial discretion, in addition to damages and other available remedies.
edits.name: Mutual remedies

receiver.message_back: The draft is broadly acceptable, subject to extending the confidentiality and use restrictions to five years from each disclosure and requiring prompt notice of any unauthorized use or disclosure, together with reasonable cooperation in mitigation. Please also require return or destruction within thirty days of written request, with written certification on request, and clarify that retained copies remain restricted and may not be used for any other purpose.

drafter.private_reasoning: The requested changes are reciprocal and consistent with the NDA’s purpose. The edits implement them while preserving the existing retention exceptions and trade-secret protections. No confidential client information is disclosed.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you. We have incorporated the five-year confidentiality and use period for each disclosure, prompt notice of unauthorized use or disclosure and reasonable mitigation cooperation, and return or destruction within thirty days of written request, with written certification upon request. Permitted retained copies remain restricted and may be used only as necessary for the applicable retention requirement or backup maintenance, not for any other purpose. The revised language is submitted for your confirmation.

edits.text: 2. CONFIDENTIALITY. In consideration of the mutual promises herein, each receiving party shall use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose and protect it with at least reasonable care and no less care than it uses for its own similar confidential information. “Confidential Information” means nonpublic information disclosed by or on behalf of a party in any form that is identified as confidential or reasonably should be understood to be confidential, including analyses reflecting that information and the existence and status of discussions. The receiving party may disclose Confidential Information only to its personnel and professional advisers who need to know it for the Purpose and are subject to confidentiality duties at least as protective as this Agreement. The receiving party is responsible for their compliance. Confidential Information excludes information the receiving party can demonstrate was lawfully known to it without restriction before disclosure, becomes public other than through a breach of this Agreement, is lawfully received from a third party without a confidentiality duty, or is independently developed without use of Confidential Information. If disclosure is legally required, the receiving party may disclose only what is required and shall, to the extent legally permitted, give prompt advance notice and reasonably cooperate, at the disclosing party’s expense, in seeking protective treatment. Upon becoming aware of any unauthorized use or disclosure of Confidential Information, the receiving party shall promptly notify the disclosing party and reasonably cooperate with it in mitigating the resulting harm and preventing further unauthorized use or disclosure. Within thirty days after written request, the receiving party shall return or destroy Confidential Information, including copies held by its personnel and professional advisers, and, upon request, certify compliance in writing. Copies required by law or professional retention requirements, and routine backups not reasonably accessible for deletion, may be retained. All retained copies remain subject to this Agreement’s confidentiality and use restrictions for as long as retained and may be accessed or used only as necessary to comply with the applicable retention requirement or maintain routine backups, and not for any other purpose.
edits.name: Confidentiality, incident notice, and return or destruction

edits.text: 3. TERM. This Agreement takes effect on the date of the last signature and remains in effect for twenty-four months. The receiving party’s confidentiality and use restrictions apply to each disclosure for five years from its disclosure date, notwithstanding expiration of this Agreement, subject to the longer protection for retained copies under Section 2. Information qualifying as a trade secret shall remain protected for as long as it qualifies as a trade secret under applicable law.
edits.name: Five-year protection period
